reasons: The claimed deviation is substantiated: p0086 supplies a 12-month software conformance warranty but no remedy, no professional-and-workmanlike services standard, no compliance-with-laws warranty and no no-malicious-code warranty, all of which the WARRANTY preferred position requires.

The redline is minimal and additive — the existing 12-month warranty sentence is left untouched and a single supplemental paragraph inserts the missing elements (services standard, 90-day conformance, repair/replace/re-perform with refund backstop, legal compliance, no malicious code), matching the model language closely enough.
Direction is correct for the customer: remedies and additional warranties run in our favour, and no vendor-favourable concession is introduced.

Comment is accurate and appropriately scoped (it says Section 12 states no remedy, which is true; the acceptance-period and best-efforts repair rights noted in the rationale are elsewhere in the agreement), uses the [Playbook] prefix and the required concise first-person-plural tone.
Deterministic checks both pass (operation applies; warranty period expressed in months/days ≥ 90 days), consistent with the substantive review.
